mcq_fix.s: Consider the following pairs: 1. Shabnam Mausi — First transgender MLA 2. Madhu Bai Kinnar — First openly transgender mayor (Raigarh, 2015) 3. Karnataka — State with a 1% transgender job quota Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
mcq_fix.why: Kamla Jaan (Katni, 2000) was elected mayor earlier; Madhu Bai Kinnar is the first openly transgender mayor

mcq_drop.why: A-R where R merely restates A's consequence; 'correct explanation' is ambiguous

notes_fix.replace: Madhu Bai Kinnar, Raigarh, Chhattisgarh (2015) - first openly transgender mayor (Kamla Jaan, Katni MP, elected 2000, later unseated) [GK]
notes_fix.why: established fact: Kamla Jaan elected mayor 2000

patterns: APPSC asks this topic only through current-affairs 'first' items: first State with 1% transgender job quota (Karnataka, July 2021).
Other PSCs ask 'first transgender judge' (Joyita Mondal, WB) with look-alike name distractors.
No PYQ yet tests NALSA holdings or 2019 Act provisions directly; expect single-fact items (year 2014, DM issues certificate, NCTP chair).
App MCQs are heavy on multi-statement items about the 2026 Amendment and NHRC advisory, deeper than PYQ depth but sound.
